open_points.subject: M07 PublicationMark.marked_at
open_points.question: What time source creates `marked_at`, what datetime representation is stored, and how many times may one mark operation read that source?
options: An injected wall clock read once, stored as UTC without an offset
An injected wall clock read once, stored as offset-aware UTC
The ambient system clock in the host's local time
A timestamp supplied by the caller
open_points.default_guess: Use an injected wall clock, read it exactly once only when a new mark is committed, and store naive UTC.

witness.initial: A placement exists and has no publication mark; the host time zone is Europe/Madrid.
events: The calling flow records the publication at 2026-07-01T10:00:00Z.
The deliverer creates M07 and writes `marked_at`.
outcomes: The record contains local naive time `2026-07-01T12:00:00`, or an offset-aware datetime.
witness.observer: A later scan, replayed mark, record reader or migration comparing the persisted timestamp

open_points.subject: A5 INV-10 Required tests
open_points.text: scan, placement and mark each answer `connection_not_confirmed` for an unconfirmed connection (`test_an_unconfirmed_connection_delivers_nothing`).
open_points.question: What must the INV-10 tests observe to prove that no source is scanned and nothing is placed or marked, rather than merely proving the returned refusal code?
options: Trap source-folder access and assert no access and no durable write for every invalid, missing or unconfirmed connection
Assert only the refusal response and absence of durable writes
Treat the prescribed check order as sufficient without a test observation
open_points.default_guess: Trap access to the source folder and assert zero source reads plus zero placement, mark and stored-image changes for every connection refusal.

open_points.subject: A1 photo-folder listing refusal
open_points.rule: Член, названный одним значением, — нарушение: значение с точкой или дефисом не является именем ни одного члена, генератор пишет только имена (`AuditAction.EXPENSE_CREATE`), и валидатор отклоняет такую note (`note_enum_member_by_value`).
open_points.question: Replace this refusal-code value with the FOLDER_UNAVAILABLE member of = models.RefusalCode.
